description: Volume IV of the First Edition, Framework Version 1.0, of the four-volume Global Artificial Intelligence Development and Competitiveness Assessment Framework.
abstract: This volume forms part of the First Edition, Framework Version 1.0, of the Global Artificial Intelligence Development and Competitiveness Assessment Framework. It develops measurement architecture, benchmarking methods, frontier indicators, comparative evaluation systems, and forward-looking analytical tools for assessing emerging AI capability and strategic trajectory. The Framework is designed as an open, extensible, and evolving assessment architecture that may be revised as AI technologies, measurement systems, benchmarking practices, strategic environments, and future-readiness requirements develop.
